text: Print the unit in every failing boundary assertion: entries, bytes, or records, next to the observed and expected values.
rationale: The first repair edit sees whether it is fixing a count, a UTF-8 byte prefix, or a Gitstatus record index.

text: Make the valid-UTF-8 truncation fixture a raw byte string and decode only after taking the expected 508-byte prefix.
rationale: The test cannot accidentally assert a character count when the contract is a 512-byte budget.

text: Build the manifest's valid fixture with exactly cap generated entries and reserve one separate overflow fixture for rejection.
rationale: The setup expresses the cap boundary once instead of manually counting a long literal.

text: Use a tuple of (record_id, line) for Gitstatus expectations and slice the tuple list before comparing IDs.
rationale: The assertion's slicing unit matches the payload unit and does not depend on string character positions.

text: Expose each edge case as a normal unittest method whose fully qualified name is the worker's only rerun token.
rationale: The parent reruns the same test loader with no heredoc, temporary probe, or alternate environment.

text: Have the parent discard scratch diagnostics after the first green rerun and retain the exact regression test diff plus raw exit.
rationale: The durable proof is one test and one command, not a growing trail of probes.
